title: Ajani Goldmane | Planeswalker
description: Duty. Honor. Valor. Learn more about the leonin warrior Planeswalker, Ajani Goldmane, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Ajani is a leonin warrior who aids his allies with potent healing and protective powers. Known across the Multiverse as a noble hero and compassionate friend, Ajani devotes himself to protecting the weak and fighting against those who seek to oppress others. As a member of the Gatewatch, Ajani often provides mentorship to his fellow Planeswalkers, seeking to help them master their gifts and grow into their best selves.
